cross_record_findings: Dwarf Fortress rounds form a chronological static-research chain: later checkpoints narrow cancellation, output, expiry and cleanup paths, but repeatedly leave consumed-source refund, full rollback, persistence and gameplay unproven. Allocation disposal, containment unlink, removal request and quantity compensation are distinct outcomes.

Across the historical research checkpoints, artifact/hash validation is consistently separate from native execution, current-version source, gameplay, save/reload/import and human review. The latter are not implied by completed documentation deliveries.

Discworld and strategy-game checkpoints preserve meaningful source/version boundaries: old distribution versus current help, community recovery versus installed Elin version, and selected IL2CPP metadata/ranges versus recovered executable bodies.
